slice: Broad review of member custody, Match Deck self-preview, Formation continuity, Bellows value, provider boundaries, and member-facing copy.
sharedContext: The local member journey is Home, Intake, Recommendations, Workshop, Match Deck, Formation, Personal Bellows, Crucible, and Membership.
Intake and recommendation reads have owner-bound server paths; Formation and several working drafts remain explicitly browser-local.
The Match Deck uses deterministic rules, synthetic Ghost profiles, visible fit reasons, location preference, and no wealth ranking.
The immediate candidate adds a preview of what deliberately supplied project facts could be shown to a future match; it does not publish or contact anyone.
No provider activation, credentials, schema/RLS, production data, spend, push, deploy, new environment, subagent, or foreground input is allowed.
liveStrings: Preview what another member could see
Check what matters before you rely on it
knownGaps: Formation and multiple Bellows artifacts remain browser-local rather than account-saved.
Real introductions are not live; the visible people are synthetic practice profiles.
Production provider activation and production data custody are outside this candidate.
Fresh CBCC dispatch routes are blocked or unproved in the current carrier state.
